info.title: EnvPit Public API
info.description: SDK/CLI-facing surface: API-key management (JWT+RBAC, org-admin-issued) and the resolved config fetch (X-Api-Key-authed). Internal/operator-only routes are not documented here — see docs/TECHNICAL_SPEC.md §6.

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: The HTTP status code (duplicated from the response status).

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. Generic/fixed text on any 5xx.

instance.description: The request path this problem occurred on.

environmentId.description: Scope the key to one environment. Omitted = every environment of the project (ADR-M5-01).

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry; the key stops working after this instant.

allowedIps.description: IP/CIDR allowlist (bd:envpit-vohj). Omitted/empty = unrestricted (any IP may use this key).

environmentId.description: null = all environments of the project.

keyPrefix.description: First 8 raw chars — the only display/log-safe identifier.

key.description: The raw API key. Shown exactly once — store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.

environmentId.description: null = all environments of the project.

keyPrefix.description: First 8 raw chars — the only display/log-safe identifier.
